reason: I'd actually want a halal collagen, but it just says 'halal-certified' and doesn't say who certified it, so I'm not handing over £18 yet. I'd screenshot it and wait to see if any of the creators I follow vouch for it.
objection: Who certified it? HMC, HFA, someone else? 'Halal-certified' with no name and no certificate to look at could mean anything, and loads of collagen brands are vague about where the bovine comes from.
would_change_my_mind: The certifying body named on the pouch with the certificate on the site, plus a Muslim beauty creator I trust using it for a few weeks and showing results.
